tools.name: ck3_ask_about_changes
tools.description: Collect a trusted native operator choice, with a separate terminal fallback.

tools.name: ck3_cancel_work
tools.description: Request safe cancellation without changing source mods.

tools.name: ck3_check_playset
tools.description: Capture and check current CK3 files; returns persistent work without launching the game.

tools.name: ck3_examine_changes
tools.description: Build a complete saved conversation index from the selected scan.

tools.name: ck3_find_missing_mod_candidates
tools.description: Search configured local roots for missing mod candidates without changing the launcher.

tools.name: ck3_find_playsets
tools.description: Discover CK3 playsets using trusted startup roots; does not activate a selection.

tools.name: ck3_get_concern_evidence
tools.description: Read bounded combined concern evidence; follow every continuation.

tools.name: ck3_get_context
tools.description: Start or resume CK3 discussion with saved work, source freshness and capability limits.

tools.name: ck3_get_definition_contributions
tools.description: Page every captured declaration of one exact definition.

tools.name: ck3_get_investigation_report
tools.description: Resume saved concern totals and remaining work without rescanning.

tools.name: ck3_get_progress
tools.description: Inspect persistent CK3 work; lab_run_get is the shared cross-toolset equivalent.

tools.name: ck3_inspect_change
tools.description: Inspect bounded saved contributions under current disclosure policy.

tools.name: ck3_inspect_mod_candidate
tools.description: Capture an operator-selected alternative candidate separately from the active selection.

tools.name: ck3_investigate_change
tools.description: Read a concise contribution comparison with base-game evidence and remedy limits.

tools.name: ck3_list_changes
tools.description: Page all indexed changes, including exact totals and explicit coverage.

tools.name: ck3_list_concerns
tools.description: Page all saved concerns with complete review accounting.

tools.name: ck3_list_missing_mods
tools.description: Page unavailable enabled mods from the saved briefing.

tools.name: ck3_make_selected_files
tools.description: Create only previously approved files in a separate inactive fixes mod.

tools.name: ck3_prepare_call_allies_choices
tools.description: Prepare exact inactive call-allies options; this grants no approval.

tools.name: ck3_read_knowledge
tools.description: Read a cited CK3 guidance entry; documentation is distinct from executed conformance.

tools.name: ck3_read_source
tools.description: Read a bounded hash-checked source excerpt under current source policy.

tools.name: ck3_read_sources
tools.description: Read bounded captured excerpts together under source exclusions.

tools.name: ck3_record_concern_review
tools.description: Record a revision-checked evidence-backed review without authorizing changes.

tools.name: ck3_related_definitions
tools.description: Inspect saved contributions and supported references with explicit unknowns.

tools.name: ck3_remember_progress
tools.description: Save the objective, discussion notes and next step; notes never grant approval.

tools.name: ck3_resume_conversation
tools.description: Resume saved discussion and pending choices without assuming completion.

tools.name: ck3_scan_playset
tools.description: Capture immutable selected CK3 sources and start a persistent scan.

tools.name: ck3_search_knowledge
tools.description: Search sourced CK3 guidance with explicit version applicability.

tools.name: ck3_search_sources
tools.description: Search captured paths, text or symbols and follow all continuation fields.

tools.name: ck3_set_version_preference
tools.description: Remember campaign-version preference without approving updates.

tools.name: ck3_undo_selected_changes
tools.description: Ask before undoing an exact inactive change; preserve intervening edits.

tools.name: ck3_use_playset
tools.description: Import a discovered playset for investigation without activating it.

tools.name: election_backtest
tools.description: Evaluate aggregate polling-error models with earlier-cycle training and explicit temporal cutoffs.

tools.name: election_forecast
tools.description: Compare bounded aggregate election margins and uncertainty under baseline, historical and reversal scenarios.

dem_win_probability.description: Probability of positive D-minus-R margin in a supported decisive-round comparison; other-candidate victories are not modeled.
dem_win_probability.title: Dem Win Probability

tools.name: election_status
tools.description: Inspect aggregate election research, public source provenance, coverage and missing-data limitations.

tools.name: eu5_definition_compare
tools.description: Read effective prediction, exact contributors and baseline as bounded JSON chunks.

tools.name: eu5_definitions_search
tools.description: Page indexed definition identities and contributor counts.

tools.name: eu5_deployment_prepare
tools.description: Prepare an immutable review plan; production deployment remains unavailable.

tools.name: eu5_finding_get
tools.description: Read a bounded JSON chunk of one snapshot-bound finding; follow its cursor.

tools.name: eu5_findings_list
tools.description: Page evidence-backed findings from a pinned EU5 snapshot.

tools.name: eu5_installations_list
tools.description: Page configured EU5 installations and synthetic fixtures.

tools.name: eu5_intent_record
tools.description: Record proposed intent; gameplay sacrifices require a separate trusted operator decision.

tools.name: eu5_mods_list
tools.description: Page registered mod IDs and captured fingerprints for one installation.

tools.name: eu5_playsets_list
tools.description: Read configured mod order; this does not establish an active game playset.

tools.name: eu5_references_list
tools.description: Page known graph edges with explicit limits on dynamic/runtime coverage.

tools.name: eu5_scan_start
tools.description: Capture registered sources and start a persistent EU5 scan. Poll lab_run_get.

tools.name: eu5_source_read
tools.description: Read at most 8192 captured source bytes by source ID, never a host path.

tools.name: eu5_validate_start
tools.description: Start complete final-stack validation of a frozen staging revision.

tools.name: eu5_workspace_create
tools.description: Create isolated revision-zero staging using the existing deterministic planner.

tools.name: eu5_workspace_diff
tools.description: Read every proposed output in bounded chunks for an exact staging revision.

tools.name: eu5_workspace_export
tools.description: Export a validated inactive experimental ZIP. Never activates a playset.

tools.name: eu5_workspace_patch
tools.description: Apply exact hash/span/ordinal-preconditioned scalar edits to staging only.

tools.name: lab_artifact_read
tools.description: Read a bounded slice of an immutable authorized artifact by ID.

tools.name: lab_capabilities
tools.description: Discover this instance, enabled toolsets, limits and unavailable capabilities.

tools.name: lab_run_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation at a safe boundary; committed effects remain reported.

tools.name: lab_run_events
tools.description: Read an ordered bounded page of persistent run events.

tools.name: lab_run_get
tools.description: Inspect persistent run state and committed results; polling does not restart work.
